The *Hetusampayuttaduka* (Patthana 8.3) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna* collection. It systematically examines conditioning relations according to the dyad (*duka*) of states associated with root causes (*hetusampayutta*) and states unassociated with root causes (*hetuvippayutta*).
